name: Brushed X
description: All white. 'GLOBAL' in big thin light blue capitals across the forward windows (the G a ring with a bar across it), a light blue brushed X after it, a big light blue brushed X across the fin running off its leading edge, and the G in light blue on the white engines.

logos.description: The brushed X, big across the fin: a broad stroke rising from the root toward the trailing edge's top, ending in a ragged brush tip under the tip, crossed by one running down from the leading edge (off it) to the trailing edge near the root.
The brushed X after GLOBAL, a little higher than the letters and about as tall as their capitals.
On the right side the X comes first from the nose, ahead of GLOBAL, so the name reads GLOBAL X there too.
The G (a ring open at the top right with a bar across it) big on the side of each cowl.

titles.style: Big thin geometric capitals across the forward windows from just behind the forward door: the G a ring with a bar across its middle running out past it on the left, an A without a crossbar.
The same lettering on the right side, aft of the X so the name reads GLOBAL X (N570TA from below, 2025-03-13).

notes: Measured on N530FL (A321, left side, El Paso, 2026-02-04), checked on N570TA (A321, 2026-07-11) and the A320s N282GX and N281GX (2023). The fin's X: the rising stroke from about a third of the root's chord to under the tip at the trailing edge, ending in a ragged brush tip; the falling one from off the leading edge at about 60% of the height to the trailing edge just above the root. GLOBAL runs from x 0.14 to 0.43, capitals from y -0.38 to 0.72 (the windows through its middle); the X after it at x 0.44-0.51, y 0.0-0.82. The G on the cowl is about three quarters of its height. A small US flag above the windows over the wing and the registration aren't drawn. The right side was seen only from below (N570TA, 2025-03-13): the X comes first from the nose there, GLOBAL after it; the fin's right side wasn't seen.
history: GlobalX's newer scheme, on its A321s and some A320s since 2023 while others keep the blue and green swoosh (GXA/standard, still on N276GX and N630VA in 2026) and a few are all blue (GXA/brush-x-blue).
